note: M1, the machine view pilot (art plan batch M). 2026-10-30. One create_1_direction_object job: size 32, view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name m1_machines, 64 candidates, 10 generations. PixelLab review object 2fb03b1c-3c21-49b3-909f-9727b0739fff (job d60e4703-97b3-4fd3-ae85-157d8e4df0db). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/m1/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot map in _slots). Chosen frames were promoted with select_object_frames (tag m1_machines); each src below is that object's image, byte-identical to its frame. Every frame came back 100% Apollo with no partial alpha and no baked drop shadow. 14 of 22 machines and 6 of 7 decor passed; the rest fall back to code-drawn art until the anchored M2 re-roll (_rejected). Decor uses the STYLE.md manifest names (x_l<layer>_<name>), which are the game's own: each layer's decor list in src/data/layers.ts; these seven are its 32 x 32 props. _light (glowing spots) and _work (where code effects go) are [x, y, w, h] in final 32 x 32 sprite pixels, after trim and bottom-centre placement, for the anchor fields of art plan issue 11 (not read by art:build yet).
_prompt: description: factory machine sprite in high top-down 3/4 view, flat top and a thin south face, square base filling the frame, selective dark outline, lit from upper left, no ground shadow. item_descriptions: the art plan's per-sprite lines (art.md, batch M), verbatim.
_slots: 0-21 machines (miner, smelter, press, assembler, foundry, generator, washer, separator, harvester, spore_collector, spore_filter, cutter, crusher, charger, overcharger, stabilizer, resonance_tap, cooling_bath, thermal_extractor, pressure_forge, precision_assembler, attuner); 22-28 decor (crate_stack, support, minecart, mushroom_tall, crystal_large, hex_pillar, stone_gear); 29-50 the 22 machines again; 51-57 the 7 decor again; 58-63 third slots (overcharger, resonance_tap, stabilizer, precision_assembler, spore_filter, separator).
